lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Trainer!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Trainnnnnerrr!!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Which do you think tastes better?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Churu or kibbles?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Nero and I are debating,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and she says churu is more delicious,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: but I personally think nothing beats a good bowl of kibble.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Kibble can't hold a candle to churu.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Kibble is plain ol' food.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Churu is a treat.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It would stand to reason that treats are more delectable than ordinary food.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm not so sure I agree.
I don't think either of them is particularly tasty.
They're pretty much the same to me.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: What is this blasphemy?!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: How can you say such a thing UㅜᴥㅜU

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You don't like either of them?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: How can someone not like kibble OR churu?!
I can envision Biscuit's drooping ears and tail right now.
Uh... just kidding! I actually think they're both delicious.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Oh U>ᴥ<U

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: So you can't really choose one or the other?
They're the same, in that they're both terrible.
But there's no need to say that out loud right now.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Interesting.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I didn't figure you would like both of them.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: If that's the case, I'll bring plenty of churu next time I come to visit.
Uh... that's okay, you don't have to do that.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Oooh, you know what would be great? Churu and kibble mixed together.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Have you ever tried that, Trainer?
Can't say I have.
Sounds a bit too indulgent for me.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: No way! If you pair two delicious things together,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: then the result will be something super duper delicious!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Let's try it together next time U>ᴥ<U

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: No, scratch that! Let's try making some right now.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Nero, get the best flavor of churu ready.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'll secure the finest kibble and come to you.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'm on it.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Nero and I will whip this up real quick and come find you, Trainer.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Be sure to save some room.
Sorry, but I'm already full.
... No one seems to be reading my message.
I better steer clear of the Commander's Room today.
